Today (the 17th), netizens uploaded clips on social media showing what appeared to be CCTV footage taken in a back alley, depicting three people chatting on site, with at least two clearly seen wearing uniforms of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD). Based on the department's uniform information, the two are suspected to be a Hawker Management Officer and a Senior Hawker Management Officer.

The footage showed the two officer-level personnel chatting in the back alley. One of them first took out a cigarette and smoked, then another Senior Hawker Management Officer walked over, took out a cigarette pack and a lighter, brushed his hair lightly, put a cigarette into his mouth, and as he walked away with his back to the camera, a wisp of smoke could be seen emanating from beside him.

"集誌社" (Press Collective) inquired with the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department as to whether the individuals in the footage are FEHD staff. The department confirmed in response to the inquiry that the individuals in the footage were personnel from the FEHD's District Hawker Management Team. A spokesperson pointed out that the incident occurred in early June this year. When reporters asked whether FEHD personnel are allowed to smoke while in uniform, whether there was any violation if the footage was genuine, and whether this would affect the department's image, FEHD replied that according to the department's established regulations, personnel are prohibited from smoking while in uniform and in public places.

FEHD stated that the department attaches great importance to the discipline and professional conduct of its staff, and has initiated a disciplinary investigation into the incident. Appropriate action will be taken in accordance with established procedures and the findings of the investigation. The spokesperson also pointed out that the department has clear requirements regarding the conduct of personnel while in uniform, and any behaviour that violates the department's disciplinary requirements will be followed up on seriously.
